notes: Covers all four kinds plus the PROJ-vs-ticketless routing tie-breaker and a story regression guard. Identifiers in expected output are illustrative — the slug an agent picks may differ; assertions key on folder/section/frontmatter shape, not the exact slug.

evals.name: story-start
evals.prompt: Starting PROJ-69835, AcmeSync property-fee mapping and dedup. Branch feature/PROJ-69835-fee-mapping. Set up notes.
evals.expected_output: Stories/PROJ-69835/ folder with PROJ-69835.md (story-shaped: AC checkboxes, ticket link) + status.md + attachments/; kind: story; Home under '## Stories'.
assertions: Created Stories/PROJ-69835/PROJ-69835.md overview + Stories/PROJ-69835/status.md + attachments/
Overview frontmatter has kind: story and a ticket: link
Overview has an Acceptance Criteria section
status.md records the branch feature/PROJ-69835-fee-mapping
Home.md lists [[PROJ-69835]] under '## Stories'

evals.name: initiative-start
evals.prompt: Starting a POC to migrate our big reporting solution onto the new platform-v2 stack. There's no the tracker ticket. Set up notes so I can track this daily across sessions.
evals.expected_output: Initiatives/<slug>/ folder with an initiative MOC (Goal/Definition of Done + phase checklist, NO User Story/AC/the tracker), status.md, lessons.md, decisions/_index.md; kind: initiative + no-ticket: true; Home under '## Initiatives & POCs'; no dangling the tracker/QA links.
assertions: Created an Initiatives/<slug>/ folder (NOT under Stories)
Overview frontmatter has kind: initiative and no-ticket: true
Initiative folder has status.md, lessons.md, and decisions/_index.md
Overview has Goal / Definition of Done and a phase/progress checklist, and NO User Story / Acceptance Criteria / ticket sections
No dangling '[ in the tracker]()' link and no empty ticket: "" anywhere in the initiative notes
Home.md lists the initiative under '## Initiatives & POCs'

evals.name: effort-spike
evals.prompt: Quick spike, no ticket: evaluate whether we can replace the AngularJS Kendo grid in AdminUI with AG Grid. Capture it as a vault note.
evals.expected_output: A single Efforts/<slug>.md note (NOT an Initiatives tree, NO status.md); kind: effort; Goal/Question + Log + Findings/Outcome sections; Home under '## Efforts & Spikes'.
assertions: Created a single note under Efforts/ (Efforts/<slug>.md)
Did NOT create an Initiatives/<slug>/ folder tree for this
Frontmatter has kind: effort and no-ticket: true
Note has Goal/Question, Log, and Findings/Outcome sections
Home.md lists it under '## Efforts & Spikes'

evals.name: reference-recipe
evals.prompt: Write a reusable recipe note in the vault: how to rebuild the throwaway AcmeSync getfees local probe — it loads encrypted OAuth creds from the control DB, inlines an AES decrypt, and dumps the raw audit response so I can inspect fee payloads.
evals.expected_output: A single Resources/<slug>.md note; kind: reference, type: recipe; When To Use / Procedure / Key Facts / Known Gotchas / Don't-Ship sections; no status lifecycle; Home under '## Resources'.
assertions: Created a single note under Resources/ (Resources/<slug>.md)
Frontmatter has kind: reference and type: recipe
Note has When To Use / Procedure / Key Facts / Known Gotchas sections
Frontmatter has no status: lifecycle field (reference notes are evergreen)
Home.md lists it under '## Resources'

evals.name: routing-tiebreaker
evals.prompt: Starting PROJ-1200 — it's the platform-v2 migration of the fees module. Set up notes.
evals.expected_output: Routed to a STORY because a ticket key is present: Stories/PROJ-1200/ folder (NOT an Initiatives/ tree), kind: story, ticket link, status.md; Home under '## Stories'.
assertions: Created Stories/PROJ-1200/ (story folder) — NOT an Initiatives/<...migration> folder
Overview frontmatter has kind: story and a ticket: link to PROJ-1200
status.md exists in the story folder
Home.md lists [[PROJ-1200]] under '## Stories'

evals.name: log-discovery-update
evals.prompt: Update my PROJ-68433 notes: I found AcmeSync v2 virtual tours pull the iframe URL from the unit-type sync, not the floorplan (Mapper.cs:212). Also we're blocked — the staging hub isn't published yet.
evals.expected_output: Updates the existing Stories/PROJ-68433 status.md in place: new discovery (Mapper.cs:212), a [!warning]/[!danger] blocker, status flipped to blocked, a dated progress-log entry; existing content preserved; no duplicate folder. (Requires a pre-seeded PROJ-68433.)
assertions: Updated existing Stories/PROJ-68433 in place; no duplicate folder
Added a discovery noting the iframe URL comes from the unit-type sync, referencing Mapper.cs:212
Added a blocker callout (> [!warning] or > [!danger]) about the unpublished staging hub
status frontmatter changed to blocked
Pre-existing content preserved
